title: One-term Tor-acyclic K-flat tensor comparison
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and B a commutative R-algebra. Let Q be a cochain complex of R-modules supported only in one degree k, meaning Q^n is zero whenever n is not k. Suppose Tor_i^R(Q^k,B)=0 for every positive integer i [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. For every K-flat R-complex P [def-pc-module-kflat-complex] and quasi-isomorphism f:P\to Q, the termwise tensor map f\otimes_R B:P\otimes_R B\to Q\otimes_R B is a quasi-isomorphism.

source.place: Section 15.60, Lemmas 15.60.7, 15.60.9, 15.60.12 and Definition 15.60.13; parent Tag 08IB final affine calculation

proof.text: Since Q is supported only in degree k, identify it with the single complex on Q^k: the degree-k component is identity, other components are the unique zero-object isomorphisms, and every differential is zero.

Take a projective resolution of Q^k and reindex its i-th term in cochain degree k-i. Its augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism to Q. It is bounded above with flat terms, so is K-flat [lem-pc-module-bounded-flat-kflat]. After tensoring its homology in degree k-i is Tor_i(Q^k,B) [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules]. In degree k the augmentation is the Tor-zero isomorphism by right exactness; below k use the stated positive Tor vanishing, and above k both sides vanish. Thus the tensor augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism.

For the specified arbitrary resolution f:P -> Q, compare it and the projective resolution via a common K-flat refinement in the homotopy category (the cofiltered resolution comparison from Tag 06XY). Its transition maps remain quasi-isomorphisms after tensoring, by [lem-pc-mixed-tensor-kflat-quasi-iso] specialized to the identity ring map and the single complex B in degree zero, identifying the mixed tensor with ordinary tensor. Their augmentation square commutes up to homotopy; tensor preserves this homotopy, and two-out-of-three gives the claim for f. No boundedness of P is used.

theorem quasiIso_tensor_of_single_support_tor_acyclic
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) (k : ℤ)
    (hsupport : ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ k → IsZero (Q.X n))
    (hTor : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj (Q.X k)).obj (ModuleCat.of R B)))
    (P : CochainComplex.KFlat (ModuleCat.{u} R)) (f : P.obj ⟶ Q)
    (hf : QuasiIso f) :
    QuasiIso ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (ModuleCat.of R B)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map f)
